title: Reuse a draft state to propose the next token
visibleProof: The draft decoder produces a_do; the same state becomes the following input with e(it), without waiting for a new target feature.
provenance: source-grounded authored trace; vector glyphs are schematic
scope: One EAGLE-3 inference drafting step; tokens remain proposals until verification.

objects.label: g_I
objects.meaning: Target feature unavailable during this step

objects.label: FC → Decoder
objects.meaning: Project concatenation, then run the draft decoder

connections.role: reuse-at-next-step; input becomes a_do with e(it)

initialFacts: earlier context remains available but is omitted

beats.title: Keep the state; add the token
beats.operation: Concatenate the previous draft state with the token embedding.

beats.title: Run the small draft decoder
beats.operation: Project the concatenation, then run the single-layer draft decoder.

beats.title: Propose the next token
beats.operation: Use the LM head and sample a draft token.

beats.title: Reuse the new state again
beats.operation: Use a_do with e(it) for the following draft step.

finalInvariant: Draft output is reusable state; proposed tokens still need target verification.
accessibleDescription: a_I and e(do) are concatenated. FC and the draft decoder produce a_do; its LM head can propose it. g_I is unavailable. The next draft step reuses a_do with e(it). This is drafting, not acceptance.

playback.timing: Illustrative pacing: input 0–2.8s, compute 2.8–6.1s, proposal 6.1–7.9s, reuse 7.9–11.3s, final hold until 15.6s, fade/reset. Not measured latency.
